desc: Displays the current system time.
Displays the current system date.
Outputs the provided text to the console.
Pauses execution for a specified number of seconds.
Logs the current time to the system log.
Logs the current date to the system log.
Opens the BananaEditor text editor (its text lives in aPE-RAM).
Runs a binary ripple counter in aPE-RAM: counter [interval_ms]. Try 'counter &'.
Starts aPE-BASIC: basic [file.bas]. Runs the file, or opens the BASIC prompt.
Displays a list of available commands.
Displays the current system version.
Fetches system information alongside a banana ASCII art.
Provides detailed information about a specific command.
Displays system information, including the motherboard hardware.
Exits the current session or application.
Lists running processes, read from the process table in aPE-RAM.
Terminates a process: kill <pid>
Brings a background process to the foreground: fg <pid>
Shows aPE-RAM usage and a map of every physical frame.
Hex-dumps a process's virtual memory: peek <pid> <addr> [length]
Lists the contents of a directory.
Changes the current working directory.
Creates a new directory.
Removes an empty directory.
Displays the contents of a text file.
Moves a file or directory to the trashbin.
Permanently deletes a file or directory.
